chapter: Career, brass bands and choice of instrument
title: Why trombone over drums, bass and piano
summary: He nearly chose drums but could not carry them, found bass and piano less appealing, and settled on trombone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
